applicability_policy.engine_code_field_semantics: Publisher values may be broad engine-family labels or variant summaries; do not assume every value is a canonical three-letter VAG engine code.

limitations: The acquired JSON contains 111 publisher generations and 2,369 publisher-verified datapoints; the exact VAG allowlist retains 20 generation candidates and 233 facts. These counts do not establish factory applicability.

The CSV endpoint is not the canonical input to this builder; the separate JSON snapshot is acquired, hashed and count-reconciled. Any future CSV acquisition must be independently hashed and reconciled before use.
The publisher's public JSON exposes provenance kinds and source counts, but not a primary-document URL or revision for each individual value.
The dataset's global multi-market label is not a market-by-market applicability map; normalized market scope remains UNKNOWN.
Generation-level ranges and broad engine-family strings do not establish an individual vehicle's exact engine, gearbox or ECU.
No exact VAG engine-to-gearbox pairs, ECU mappings, DTCs, wiring diagrams, pinouts, adaptations or repair procedures are established by this dataset.
Any future integration must remain a separate CC BY-SA 4.0 database with visible attribution and Share-Alike compliance; do not merge it into a differently licensed production database.
The exact source JSON is pinned for the separate research pack only; no values have been imported into the production vehicle or technical library database.
